articles.title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
articles.snippet: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on collision course.

articles.title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day
articles.snippet: Changpeng Zhao says Anthropic-linked tokens from bStocks, Ondo and xStocks will hit BNB Chain on day one of the AI giant’s Nasdaq debut. This follows a $500 million pre-IPO rush that comes with notable fine print.

articles.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

articles.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
articles.snippet: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

articles.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
articles.snippet: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.
